PLAN "Pregnancy Strength Programme: Weeks 20-32"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain strength safely through pregnancy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 Maintain Strength" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower A":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 2x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x5 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
